_what: The fixed sentence set for the voice listening test. Rendered three ways (Kokoro af_heart, your voice via F5-TTS, your voice via Chatterbox) so the owner can compare the SAME words across engines. Chosen to exercise every surface: a greeting, questions, a long sentence, numbers, minimal pairs (the accent task's core), and a short teaching passage.
_why: A mass render of 4,875 clips must never happen on faith. This is the 20-sentence proof heard first.
